summary: Reviewed the dispatched 8-task proposal against the live repository and wrote the refined plan to PLAN-run-mtze6lyq-t83x.md (39,857 bytes, 482 lines). Verified in this checkout: 225 structure records across 19 files (not 197; 195 carry origin3d/size3d, 30 do not), tracts.json = 23 records and byte-identical to HEAD, 26 syndromes in 3 files, 15 plates / 360 labelled regions / 439 SVG <text> elements, 248 taxonomy rows (225 authored + 23 tract rows), 138 committed mesh parts with bboxes. Ran the full gate sweep and recorded exit codes; corrected eleven premises: (1) the 12 cranial-nerve courses are NERVE_COURSES in src/geometry/curves.ts, NOT in tracts.json, so the integrator's write scope is extended to curves.ts with the .dsh-swarm/_regen-curves.mjs recipe; (2) the two 'red BEFORE this run' gates are not red - verify:area-toggles exits 0 with 455/0 assertions and the preset click sites were already re-pointed by v14's review-qa and sit uncommitted in the tree, so the reviewer must verify rather than redo; (3) the actually-red gates are verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit, both failing on spawnSync EPERM (anatomy-qa.mjs:294 pipes powershell), matching README tier 2, with two named dispositions; (4) size3d is a marker-radius fallback used only when a record has no GLB (types.ts:50, NucleusMesh.tsx:184), so mesh-vs-size3d gaps on the 81 id-matched records are not defects; (5) the predicted laterality defect does not exist - 0 of 195 records contradict sign/laterality; (6) the cerebellum records live in medulla.json, not telencephalon; (7) the 5 plates with levelId undefined are all sagittal/coronal and that is correct; (8) nerve tube radii are already 0.42-1.88 au (4.5x), each from its own calibreMm at 1 au = 1.2 mm. Found four concrete pre-existing defects with evidence and assigned each an owner: vasc-middle-cerebral-artery.supply wrongly includes syn-lateral-medullary (critical, internal contradiction with the PICA/vertebral lists); tract-optic-radiation.levels names y=48/78 anchors >18 au outside its own waypoint y-range of 14-30 (major); 5 cerebellum records filed in medulla.json; ctx-cerebellum laterality midline vs its own 'hemispheres and vermis' name. Documented the concurrency rules (auditors read-only on src/**, docs/audit/v15/ absent and created concurrently, heavy pipeline/build steps serialised) and the verification plan per task and at close. Modified no data, script, or gate file - git status confirms only PLAN-run-mtze6lyq-t83x.md was added by this review.
